subject.title: feat(models): support explicit provider display order and displayName in models.providers

question: Should friendly provider labels and ordering become a persistent cross-surface catalog/config contract or remain a Control UI-only preference?
rationale: Both approaches solve the reported UX, but they create different long-term public contracts; repository policy requires explicit product judgment before adding new configuration fields.

options.title: Catalog presentation metadata
options.body: Add generic optional provider label and order metadata to configured catalog output, define its config or plugin sources, and consume it consistently across picker surfaces.

options.title: Control UI preference
options.body: Store aliases and ordering as a UI preference, keeping runtime provider configuration transport-focused but limiting the behavior to that interface.

options.title: Keep identifier sorting
options.body: Retain deterministic provider-ID sorting and document that configuration object insertion order is not a presentation contract.

recommendation.title: Catalog presentation metadata
recommendation.body: Add generic optional provider label and order metadata to configured catalog output, define its config or plugin sources, and consume it consistently across picker surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available recent ownership signal is sustained work on the Control UI chat and picker-adjacent experience.
